mentions.name: Minifigure/Garage Kit Painting Site
mentions.description: This site helps minifigure and garage kit painters track and plan paint combinations. It accounts for how wet paint differs from dry paint, how colors combine through transparent layers, and how different manufacturers' binders and pigments affect results. Work in progress includes generating minifigure 3D gaussian splats from a single image.
mentions.problem: Keeping track of paint and color combinations is tedious because wet paint color differs from dry paint color, colors combine based on the transparency of layers, and different companies use different binders and pigments.
mentions.audience: Hobbyists who paint minifigures and garage kits.
mentions.source_excerpt:
making a minifigure/garage kit painting site.

If you're in the hobby, the issue is that keeping track of paint and color combinations is annoying and is very mind numbing since wet paint color differs from dry point colors, how colors combine due to transparency of the layers, and different companies have different binders/pigments.
mentions.author: MbappeSpecial
